# Vendored: Testamur `CheckpointFormat`

This directory is a **verbatim copy** of the `Testamur.CheckpointFormat` package
tree from the sibling `nichobbs/testamur` repository. It is the checkpoint-format
contract (the data model, canonical JSON, content addressing, signing hooks, and
the capture→checkpoint mapper) that `CloudAgents.CheckpointBridge`
(`src/capture/checkpoint_bridge.l`) uses to emit a captured `claude -p` session in
the Testamur checkpoint format.

## Why a copy (for now)

cloud-agents has no dependency on testamur, and Lyric consumes third-party code
only through NuGet — so until the checkpoint-format contract is published as a
Lyric ecosystem NuGet package (the intended end state, tracked below), the only
way to reach it from here is to vendor a copy. This was a deliberate decision:
*copy now, migrate to the NuGet package later.* When that package exists, delete
this directory and replace the `[project.packages]` entries with a `[nuget]`
dependency — the package names are unchanged (`Testamur.CheckpointFormat[.*]`), so
the swap is a manifest change, not a source change.

## Source of truth — do not edit here

These files are **generated by copying**, not authored here. Do not edit them in
cloud-agents: fix bugs upstream in testamur and re-copy, or the vendored copy will
silently diverge. The package names are kept identical to upstream
(`Testamur.CheckpointFormat`, `.Canon`, `.Sign`, `.Model`, `.Chain`, `.Adapt`) so
content addresses computed here are byte-identical to those testamur computes for
the same input.

### Provenance

- **Source repo**: `github.com/nichobbs/testamur`
- **Source commit**: `0aac550340a13ec81ca41dd191dd67abea8215d4` (`main`)
- **Source paths**: `src/checkpoint_format.l`, `src/checkpoint_format/{canon,sign,model,chain,adapt}.l`
- **Copied**: 2026-08-15

### File hashes (SHA-256 of the copied bytes)

Regenerate with `sha256sum` after any re-copy and update this table; the
cross-repo drift-guard test (`tests/checkpoint_bridge_tests.l`) additionally
asserts that a fixed transcript maps to the exact content addresses testamur
computes for it, so a behavioral drift fails CI even if a hash update is missed.

```
63aa423db5741b3c32ef0f1dd7571bcff4bf570f81dd716f470a788ef06256ba  checkpoint_format.l
7ef0b8944b072b2e2ff4a8d5c37cf5be18da19a79896bc4191af06ede4980145  checkpoint_format/adapt.l
09aa627295f86d1477257a7fdd68ad380141222e9322784ed9c92620366b3d56  checkpoint_format/canon.l
672e5794700c1956b713e21b778ab405fa09d3e9eb85edadf4365efbc8a6495b  checkpoint_format/chain.l
d174f949203a46fced7130bb7b95784c488735ab85559e12d552fe9cc8f32df0  checkpoint_format/model.l
20de41a5c16b5cff09179c627f227a5b4b3181e40226fd6769d8936d28cb063d  checkpoint_format/sign.l
```

## Migration to NuGet (end state)

1. Publish `Testamur.CheckpointFormat` (at least `.Model`/`.Canon`/`.Chain`/
   `.Adapt`) as a Lyric NuGet package from the testamur repo.
2. Add it to cloud-agents `lyric.toml` `[nuget]`.
3. Delete this `vendor/testamur-checkpoint-format/` tree and its
   `[project.packages]` entries.
4. `CloudAgents.CheckpointBridge` keeps compiling unchanged — same package names.
